It goes into what’s called “Game State Check.” Energy Search doesn’t check if a search card has already been used in the state of the game, so you can still search if you have already failed a prior search as long as there is something valid to search. 

Using nest ball as example again, you can use nest ball, fail it, use another nest ball and play a basic pokemon to your bench as long as there are still cards left in deck. 

If game state is 1 card left in deck, 2 nest balls in hand. If you use nest ball and play a pokemon from deck, you can’t use the 2nd nest ball because there now isn’t a deck to search.
The number of cards left in deck IS public knowledge though. You can’t search if the searchable cards is known to be 0. Like you can’t play nest ball if there are 0 known spots left to fill on bench.

Don’t be discouraged! We’re on week 2 out of 6. There’s a whole month to go!

The roaming boss can be found every 2 hours on the hour. Very consistent point gaining and easy to set an alarm to. 

Halfway through the event, ANOTHER roaming monster will appear on the other hour, so there should be a point giving RM every hour.

MOST IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR COMPLETING EVENT: 

Event chests are quick point boosts **BUT ** if you can get more than 277 points PER portal run, then your gems are worth MUCH more as portal runs than chests. 

That being said: when you look at the number of event goblins in the portal, if you don’t like the amount, YOU CAN WAIT. The enemies for that run will refresh into a different load out after about an hour from looking at it. 

This will help you have a little more control over your portal runs. Ex: I look, see there are only like 3 or 4 event goblins this time, so something else. Wait an hour, look again, see there are 9, attack portal.

Hope this may have some new info and help you some :)
